annotation_units: per visible and decidable instance; same-frame frames must contain all visible instances of both classes

bbox.class0: tight bbox around visible central-tower body (tower silhouette incl. roof-light housing); truncated edges follow annotator visual judgement
bbox.class1: tight bbox around visible MS1 structure (thin tall flat-top column with side green light and blue side strip)

class0.name: green_roof_light
class0.visibility: v=1 only when the green roof light centre is visible and locatable; v=0 otherwise; never interpolate from bbox

class1.name: NOT_AVAILABLE
class1.visibility: v=0 always; no keypoint guess; bbox centre is forbidden as a substitute; keypoint loss must exclude class1 instances (verify mask)

rules: MS1 instances must never be treated as background in a same-frame image
target partially occluded but decidable -> label visible part + occluded flag; fully occluded -> tower_present=true, no bbox, GT_UNOBSERVABLE (not a negative)
MS1 only (tower absent/out of view): tower_present=false + class1 instance; this is the MS1 confuser case
do not delete hard frames; TINY/small-scale frames are labelled and reported separately
the green-light centroid annotation is a proxy/algorithmic-assisted reference (same green cue family); it is not independent physical truth and must be recorded as such
annotation is agent-proxy, not independent human GT
